item.title: まだしも (madashimo)
item.description:
まだしも (madashimo)

    Meaning: would be much better, would be acceptable
    Example: If it was next month that would be better, but it isn't going to happen until next year.

  [ View this entry online ]

  Notes:

  Examples:  
Note: visit WWWJDIC to lookup any unknown words found in the example(s)...
Alternatively, view this page on POPjisyo.com or Rikai.com

  • 一度ならまだしもここまで六回その言葉を間違えって書いた。   [ex #6242]
    • Once would be acceptable, but you've misspelled that word six times now.
  • この方がまだしもあれよりよい。   [ex #6245]
    • This would be better than that.
  • こんなひどい目に合うよりまだしも死んだほうがよい。   [ex #6246]
    • I would rather die than have such a terrible experience.
  • すうじつならまだしも１０日も滞納している。   [ex #6247]
    • A few days would have been excusable but you are in arrears for 10 days.
